description: NaPrS₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PrS₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent PrS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. All Na-S bond lengths are 2.97 Å. Pr³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form PrS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent PrS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. All Pr-S bond lengths are 2.87 Å. S²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Pr³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Pr₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
